name: City National Bank Crystal Visa Infinite® Credit Card

localized_names.en: City National Bank Crystal Visa Infinite® Credit Card

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: Additional Card Fee of $95 annually for each card issued after the first card.

apr.notes: APR for Purchases and Balance Transfers is 20.50% or 24.50% when you open your account, based on creditworthiness; thereafter varies with the Prime Rate (margin of 13.75% or 17.75%). Cash Advance APR is 26.50% (margin of 19.75%). Minimum interest charge $0.70. As of July 24, 2026.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees (Foreign Transaction: None).

credit_required.notes: Relationship-based product for high-net-worth clients; not publicly marketed with a credit-score band.

base_rate.description: Earn rates are governed by the separately provided City National Rewards Program Terms, Conditions and Program Rules (www.cnb.com/rewards); not disclosed in the card agreement.

rewards.redemption_notes: Rewards services and awards are described in the City National Rewards Program Terms and City National Rewards Householding Program Rules, available at www.cnb.com/rewards. Terms may change at any time.

benefits.title: City National Rewards® Program
benefits.description: Access to the City National Rewards program and Householding Program; services and awards described in separately provided Rewards Program Terms (www.cnb.com/rewards).

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fee on purchases made outside the United States (Foreign Transaction: None per pricing information).

benefits.title: Visa Infinite® benefits
benefits.description: Card is a Visa Infinite product; third-party and network-provided benefits and services may apply but are not described in the card agreement and may be added, deleted or changed without notice.

notes: Requires in-branch application or calling (800) 773-7100. Relationship-based product for high-net-worth clients. Pricing verified from the Crystal Visa Infinite Credit Card Agreement (ID 65903E, Rev 07/2026, as of July 24, 2026): $400 annual fee, $95 additional card fee, purchase APR 20.50%–24.50% variable, cash advance APR 26.50% variable, no foreign transaction fee. Earn rates are not in the agreement — they live in the separately provided City National Rewards Program Terms (www.cnb.com/rewards), so rewards.base_rate.points_per_dollar is null. No public landing page; the live cnb.com credit-cards page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so the card agreement PDF is the primary source.
